name: 敵_騎馬弓兵_落馬_4コマ_v2.png
prompt: Edit this four-frame cavalry-archer fall strip. Preserve same rider and horse, painted game style, blue archer armor, pink-red helmet plume, long bow, quiver, brown horse, blue fringed caparison and white socks. Change only framing and horse pose: horse MUST stay in its normal full RIGHT-facing profile with all four hooves close to the same low ground line in all four cells, never rear upright. This keeps horse at the same 80%-cell standing scale as its existing gallop sprite and prevents an oversized pose. Four stages: rider begins sliding off saddle; rider thrown curled toward LEFT; rider lands on back left of horse; rider settles on left. Horse stays calmly planted to the RIGHT. Maintain at least16px empty margin around rider+horse+bow in every 384 square frame, groups do not overlap. Keep the rider physically full-sized, head/torso consistent with the mounted version. Exact one-row four cells, 1536x384, magenta pure background, no lines/text/labels/shadow.
